intent.proves: The layout has exactly one catch-all group, so a field that is placed nowhere still has one place on the screen.
intent.scope: The active layout of the product edit screen (Dynamicweb.Products.UI.Screens.ProductEditScreen) against the build's declared families and editLayout; complete SQL enumeration of ScreenLayout, ScreenLayoutTab, ScreenLayoutGroup and ScreenLayoutEditor, read once per run.

bindings.reason: Needs an authenticated full payload of every layout with its screen type, tabs, groups (with the catch-all flag) and editor system names, measured for scope parity with the SQL read; descriptor existence alone is insufficient.
The measured MCP tool set has no screen layout read.
